stages.name: Existing tools + blog upgrade
features: RETAIN/VERIFY: Daily Protein Target calculator (no engine rewrite; audit source, safety and email)
RETAIN/VERIFY: Diabetes Risk Screening tool (actual deployed engine must be identified; approved safety pathways)
ADD: Tools-first homepage, navigation and two-tool hub/landing pages
ADD: Contextual article-to-tool and tool-to-article links; reviewed methodology/limitation pages
ADD: Privacy-safe aggregate referral/click analytics; clinical, security and regression controls
DO NOT ADD: new calculators, member accounts, persistent personal tracking, subscriptions or mobile app.

stages.name: Website membership & improvement MVP
features: ADD: Secure member registration, recovery, consent/preferences and adult eligibility
ADD: Health Goal Selector (up to three goals) and editable preferences
ADD: Explainable personalised article/tool suggestions from reviewed WordPress categories
ADD: Four-week Healthy Habits programme, actions, enrolment and progress check-ins
ADD: Basic member dashboard, account data export/deletion and notifications settings
ADD: Optional premium membership/payment and clear free-versus-paid access
ADD: Secure shared backend/API, clinical tool registry, account entitlements, admin reports and early-access tracking
REUSE: Two approved public tools; add save-result capability only after privacy/data-governance approval.

stages.name: Cross-platform mobile application
features: ADD: Flutter iOS and Android apps, onboarding, Home/Tools/Progress/Learn/Profile
ADD: Blood-pressure, weight and waist manual logs and trend charts
ADD: Protein/energy/fibre targets and manual food/macronutrient tracker, saved meals
ADD: Goal/programme synchronisation, personalised reviewed content, bookmarks and subscriptions/restore purchase
ADD: Optional simple activity and sleep diary, reminders and shareable personal progress summary
ADD: Offline public-article reading, feedback, secure mobile identity and server feature flags
REUSE: Stage 2 shared backend, approved tool engines and WordPress knowledge content.

stages.name: Unified advanced health platform
features: ADD: Logged-in personalised website dashboard sharing mobile user identity, goals and progress
ADD: Enhanced explainable recommendation rules, editorial approvals and member data portability
ADD: Packaged food barcode lookup with source/provenance checks
OPTIONAL: Recipe nutrition builder and user-correctable AI food-photo suggestions
OPTIONAL: Consented Apple Health / Android health-platform imports where feasible
ADD: Cross-platform privacy-preserving conversion analytics and performance reporting
REASSESS: Newspaper theme performance/compatibility (replace only if justified); localisation and community remain optional.
